product_overview: SudanFree is a mobile and web freelance marketplace for Sudan that combines job matching, social networking, real-time chat, maps, communities, shops, and safety tooling. It supports Arabic and English users across Android, iOS, and web with Firebase-backed authentication, data, notifications, and admin moderation.
core_goals: Enable freelancers and clients to connect through job listings, proposals, and job completion workflows.
Provide a social feed for posts, media sharing, stories, reactions, comments, and sharing.
Support real-time communication through secure one-on-one chat with rich media messaging.
Help users discover freelancers, shops, jobs, and communities through search and interactive maps.
Deliver notifications, safety alerts, reporting, and moderation tools for trust and platform safety.
Offer localized, personalized experiences with Arabic/English support, RTL, theme controls, and lite mode.

features.name: Authentication & User Management
features.description: Allows users to register, sign in, verify identity, and complete onboarding with profile setup for freelancer, client, or shop owner roles.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with email/password or OAuth payload -> Receive 201 with pending verification/session state -> POST /auth/otp/send with phone number -> Receive 200 with OTP dispatch confirmation -> POST /auth/otp/verify with valid code -> Receive 200 with verified account and onboarding token -> POST /users/profile with name, role, location, and skills -> Receive 200 with completed profile and access to home

POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /auth/otp/verify with expired or incorrect code -> Receive 400 invalid OTP -> GET /users/me without valid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Social Feed
features.description: Enables creation and engagement on posts containing text and media, including stories, mentions, link previews, likes, comments, replies, and sharing.
user_flows: POST /posts with text and optional media attachments -> Receive 201 with created post -> GET /posts/feed -> Receive 200 with ranked feed including new post -> POST /posts/{postId}/like -> Receive 200 with updated like count -> POST /posts/{postId}/comments with a comment body -> Receive 201 with comment created -> POST /posts/{postId}/share -> Receive 200 with share action recorded

POST /posts with oversized or unsupported media -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /posts/{postId}/comments with missing text and invalid auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized or 400 invalid payload -> GET /posts/feed -> Receive 200 with feed excluding failed post creation

features.name: Freelance Marketplace (Jobs)
features.description: Supports clients posting jobs, freelancers browsing opportunities, submitting proposals, and managing offer, completion, and review flows.
user_flows: POST /jobs with title, budget, category, location, and deadline -> Receive 201 with published job -> GET /jobs -> Receive 200 with searchable job listings -> POST /jobs/{jobId}/proposals with cover letter, budget, and timeline -> Receive 201 with proposal created -> GET /jobs/{jobId}/proposals -> Receive 200 with proposal list -> POST /jobs/{jobId}/offer/{proposalId}/accept -> Receive 200 with accepted offer and active job state -> POST /jobs/{jobId}/review with rating and feedback -> Receive 201 with review recorded

POST /jobs with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /jobs/{jobId}/proposals with invalid auth or closed job -> Receive 401 unauthorized or 409 conflict -> POST /jobs/{jobId}/offer/{proposalId}/accept on rejected proposal -> Receive 409 offer acceptance denied

features.name: Freelancer Discovery
features.description: Helps clients browse and filter freelancer profiles by skill, location, rating, reviews, endorsements, and portfolio information.
user_flows: GET /freelancers?skill=design&location=Khartoum -> Receive 200 with filtered freelancer results -> GET /users/{userId} -> Receive 200 with freelancer profile, portfolio, and reviews -> POST /users/{userId}/endorsements -> Receive 201 with endorsement recorded -> POST /chat/threads with freelancer userId -> Receive 201 with chat thread created

GET /freelancers with unsupported filter values -> Receive 400 invalid filter request -> GET /users/{userId} for missing freelancer -> Receive 404 not found -> POST /users/{userId}/endorsements without permission -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Real-Time Chat
features.description: Provides one-on-one messaging with text, image, audio, and file support, including reactions, replies, presence, and contact logs.
user_flows: POST /chat/threads with recipient userId -> Receive 201 with new thread -> GET /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages -> Receive 200 with message history -> POST /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages with text or media -> Receive 201 with message stored and realtime sync triggered -> POST /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}/reactions -> Receive 200 with reaction updated -> GET /chat/threads/{threadId}/presence -> Receive 200 with online/offline status

POST /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages with unsupported file type -> Receive 400 invalid media -> GET /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /chat/threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}/reactions for deleted message -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Interactive Map
features.description: Lets users discover freelancers and shops on an interactive clustered map with location services and region detection.
user_flows: GET /map/regions/detect with current coordinates -> Receive 200 with detected region -> GET /map/items?type=freelancer&region=selectedRegion -> Receive 200 with nearby results -> GET /map/markers -> Receive 200 with clustered markers -> GET /users/{userId} or /shops/{shopId} from a marker tap -> Receive 200 with profile card details

GET /map/regions/detect with invalid coordinates -> Receive 400 invalid location -> GET /map/items without location permission or token -> Receive 401 unauthorized or 403 location denied -> GET /map/markers with no matching items -> Receive 200 with empty marker set

features.name: Squads (Communities)
features.description: Supports public and private community groups with squad-specific posts, discussions, and member management.
user_flows: POST /squads with group name, privacy, and description -> Receive 201 with squad created -> POST /squads/{squadId}/join -> Receive 200 with membership granted or join request queued -> POST /squads/{squadId}/posts with content -> Receive 201 with squad post created -> GET /squads/{squadId}/feed -> Receive 200 with squad-specific discussions -> POST /squads/{squadId}/leave -> Receive 200 with membership removed

POST /squads with duplicate name or invalid privacy -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /squads/{squadId}/join to private squad without approval -> Receive 403 access denied -> POST /squads/{squadId}/posts without membership -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Shops
features.description: Allows business users to create shop profiles and showcase products or services for discovery and contact.
user_flows: POST /shops with shop name, description, and category -> Receive 201 with shop created -> POST /shops/{shopId}/products with item details and images -> Receive 201 with product listed -> GET /shops -> Receive 200 with browseable shop list -> GET /shops/{shopId} -> Receive 200 with shop profile and catalog -> POST /chat/threads with shop owner userId -> Receive 201 with contact chat thread created

POST /shops with missing business information -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /shops/{shopId}/products without owner permission -> Receive 403 forbidden -> GET /shops/{shopId} for deleted shop -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Smart Search
features.description: Provides global search across users, jobs, posts, shops, and squads with filters, suggestions, and search history.
user_flows: GET /search?q=designer&type=users -> Receive 200 with matching user results -> GET /search?q=design&type=jobs&location=Khartoum -> Receive 200 with filtered job results -> GET /search/suggestions?q=des -> Receive 200 with suggested queries -> GET /search/history -> Receive 200 with recent searches

GET /search without query parameter -> Receive 400 invalid search request -> GET /search?q=<script> -> Receive 200 with sanitized no-match or safe results -> GET /search/history without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Delivers push, in-app, and local notifications for chat, jobs, social activity, and system events.
user_flows: GET /notifications -> Receive 200 with notification center items -> POST /notifications/mark-read with notification ids -> Receive 200 with updated read state -> POST /notifications/subscribe with device token and channel preferences -> Receive 200 with subscription saved -> Cloud Function sends FCM notification after an event -> Receive push notification on device

GET /notifications with invalid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /notifications/mark-read with unknown notification ids -> Receive 404 not found -> POST /notifications/subscribe with malformed device token -> Receive 400 invalid registration data

features.name: Safety Alerts
features.description: Provides emergency alerts, safety guidance, and reporting for users, posts, jobs, and other content.
user_flows: POST /reports with target type, target id, and reason -> Receive 201 with report submitted -> GET /reports/{reportId} -> Receive 200 with report status -> POST /safety/alerts with emergency details -> Receive 201 with alert broadcast initiated -> GET /safety/guidelines -> Receive 200 with safety guidance content

POST /reports with missing reason or target -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /safety/alerts without permission or during rate limit -> Receive 403 forbidden or 429 too many requests -> GET /reports/{reportId} for unknown report -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Settings & Personalization
features.description: Lets users customize appearance, language, data usage, privacy, and account management settings, including updates and deletion.
user_flows: GET /users/me/settings -> Receive 200 with current preferences -> PATCH /users/me/settings with theme, language, and lite mode changes -> Receive 200 with updated settings -> PATCH /users/me/profile with edited account details -> Receive 200 with updated profile -> POST /app/update/check -> Receive 200 with update availability status

PATCH /users/me/settings with unsupported locale or theme value -> Receive 400 invalid settings -> PATCH /users/me/profile without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> DELETE /users/me/account with confirmation missing -> Receive 400 deletion confirmation required

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Provides a web-based moderation and operations dashboard for managing users, content, and verification requests.
user_flows: GET /admin/dashboard -> Receive 200 with summary metrics -> GET /admin/users -> Receive 200 with paginated user list -> POST /admin/reports/{reportId}/resolve -> Receive 200 with moderation action recorded -> GET /admin/verifications -> Receive 200 with pending KYC requests -> POST /admin/verifications/{requestId}/approve -> Receive 200 with verification approved

GET /admin/dashboard without admin role -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /admin/users/{userId}/ban with invalid reason -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /admin/verifications/{requestId}/approve for already processed request -> Receive 409 conflict

project.name: SudanFree
project.description: A freelance marketplace and social platform for Sudan, connecting freelancers with clients. Includes social feed, job postings, real-time chat, map features, squads (communities), shops, and safety alerts.

services: Firebase Auth (Email/Password, Google Sign-In, Facebook Auth)

social_feed: Create/edit/delete posts (text, images, videos, audio, files)
search: Search across users, jobs, posts, shops, squads

screens: jobs/ (job listings, job detail, post job)
